description: The function returned from an Effect. Runs before the next setup (with old values) and on unmount.
An Effect describes how to start and stop syncing with an external system for the current props and state.
Props, state and values computed from them during render. Effects must list every reactive value they read.
In development, React runs setup, cleanup, setup to reveal missing cleanups.
`removeEventListener` must receive the exact function passed to `addEventListener`.
